result.title: Density-Level Backward Error for Low-NFE Generative Flows
result.comment: 37 pages, including appendices. Accepted as a poster at ICOMP 2026
result.summary: Low-NFE generative ODE sampling is constrained not only by solver order, but also by how a fixed budget of network evaluations is distributed along the flow. We develop a density-level backward-error framework that identifies the component of a solver's modified-equation defect that changes the evolving marginal, while excluding solenoidal trajectory distortion that is invisible in Wasserstein tangent geometry. The resulting residual induces a solver-order-aware compute-allocation rule and, through gauge freedom, an objective for selecting numerically favorable velocity representatives of the same density path. This separates our approach from schedule search driven by trajectory or endpoint surrogates and from higher-order solver design. Exact Gaussian and mixture models establish the mechanism, including cases where curvature-based allocation fails and continuum-optimal transport is not discretization-optimal. On a pretrained CIFAR-10 EDM probability-flow ODE, density-aware allocation consistently improves fixed-update Euler sampling in the low-NFE regime. Matched-seed convergence to a dense Euler reference confirms that the method accelerates approximation of the same high-NFE flow rather than changing the asymptotic sampler.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对低 NFE 生成 ODE 采样，提出密度层面的 backward-error 框架，把求解器修正方程缺陷中真正改变边缘分布的成分与在 Wasserstein 切几何中不可见的螺线管式轨迹畸变区分开，据此导出与求解器阶数相关的计算分配规则，并用规范自由度选取数值上更有利的速度代表；在高斯/混合模型和 CIFAR-10 EDM ODE 上验证固定步数 Euler 采样的改进。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属图像生成采样而非 VLM 推理，但其「哪些更新真正改变分布、哪些只是轨迹冗余」的缺陷分解与固定预算下的分配规则，可能为 LVR 中潜在状态更新贡献分配、动态计算与步数预算的度量提供可核查的类比线索。
